upstream.selection_rule: Only reviewed JSON-RPC, lifecycle, tool, ping, and cancellation source from Sources/MCP may be added; all retained adaptations are data-only and exclude client and network surfaces.

adaptations.reason: Keeps JSON-RPC scalar encoding while representing a null request ID explicitly and naming the integer case int for LocalOCR's typed contract.
Retains the JSON Value wire cases, Codable behavior, literal construction, accessors, and upstream-compatible data URL parsing and text/plain default encoding needed by LocalOCR schemas and results.
Retains JSON-RPC standard and server errors, including Value-shaped error data and peer-message detail fallback, while removing URL elicitation, transport errors, and the System dependency.
Retains public JSON-RPC request, response, and notification encoding while removing type-erased dispatch boxes that belong to the later server lifecycle implementation.
Uses data-only nested lifecycle capability and implementation records instead of importing upstream Client and Server actors or their HTTP context.
Limits the supported protocol set to the LocalOCR stdio compatibility versions and exposes deterministic negotiation without unrelated SDK version expansion.
Relocates the unchanged ping method into the audited Base directory used by the local module.
Relocates the cancellation notification into the audited Base directory and retains only its request ID and reason wire fields.
Retains the upstream actor-isolated Data transport surface while naming only the local newline-delimited byte contract.

Hardens the upstream POSIX stdio transport with a one MiB input frame bound, CRLF normalization, bounded overflow draining followed by fail-closed transport termination with a content-free parse error and no dispatch of the oversized or following payload, an eight-frame fail-closed receive queue, receive-consumer termination handling, FIFO complete writes with cancellation-aware waiter removal, broken-pipe suppression, exact-once stream completion, idempotent disconnect, and content-free logging.

Retains LocalOCR's tool definitions, optional-annotation decoding, schemas, text content, list, and call messages while removing icons, resources, media, and resource-link content types, and routes generic structured results explicitly through the Value overload to avoid recursive initializer selection.

Adapts the upstream server to a strict inbound-only stdio lifecycle with structured JSON-RPC params, an atomic initializing claim, ping, tools/list, tools/call, cancellation, correlated concurrent responses, separate fixed eight-request reservation and live-handler limits, deterministic standard and overload errors, generation-scoped terminal-send ownership, and content-free diagnostics; removes client requests, batches, HTTP context, resources, prompts, sampling, elicitation, roots, subscriptions, logging control, and every network-related surface.

Adds a bounded local actor registry with monotonic reservation leases that atomically distinguishes duplicate and overloaded requests, retains IDs through explicit executing and terminal-sending states, bounds cancellation-insensitive live handlers separately, prevents stale handler completion from mutating a reused ID, makes cancellation idempotent, and cancels outstanding tasks during connection teardown.
